# PR #135 lifecycle repair review

## A. Verdict

**block** at `af50381aafd734a57d0ae169821788e38a37314f`.

Residual **F001-A and F001-B are closed**. One new #141 integration finding, F004 below, emits an impossible recreation command for a retired role still named by unfinished work. The prior reviewer F002/F003 dispositions stand.

## B. Scope

Reviewed non-merge fixes `702b73c`, `5127ee0`, `af50381` and their integration with imported main, especially #141's directory view. The supplied detached checkout stayed clean and pinned. No local builds/tests, mutation runs, runtime probes, product edits or checkout movement.

The separately routed F85 command sites are excluded. Security owns S001 and its failed-notification F002 assessment; performance owns its independent cost verdict.

## C. F001 closure and lock ordering

**A, re-entry:** drain holds the shared project/role gate before claiming and through delivery admission plus delivered/requeued settlement. Retire/merge checks the indexed delivering rows under that same gate, before queued-drop permission or commit. This is a **brake**: removing it permits more retirement, not different deletion policy. Immediate-holder routing transfers its gate to the independently owned delivering-row insert; once the insert settles, the durable delivering row supplies the fence.

**B, cancellation:** queued inserts and withdrawals capture the guard inside the store's `owned_write` task. `commit_keeping` captures it in the blocking writer job and returns it only after the commit, so dropping the waiter cannot free admission while the write can still land. Ordinary refusals release it without mutation.

No gate/writer/admission deadlock was found in these paths: the assignment hook spawns drain instead of synchronously waiting for it; drained delivery does not reacquire directory admission; the blocking writer does not acquire another role gate; post-commit `flushed` indexes ends, and withdrawal's owned publication callback performs only the store transaction.

CI covers a drain blocked before its claim, delivering refusal for retire/drop/merge, explicit failed-claim release and boot recovery followed by queued refusal/withdrawal, plus a cancelled insert behind `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` and a cancelled retire inside a pausing validator. These are the relevant missing schedules. Failure/recovery rows are seeded/settled directly rather than driven by a real process crash; coder-reported mutation controls were not rerun by this reviewer.

## D. F004: unfinished step needs can recommend recreating a retained retired ID

**P2**, `community/directory.rs:426-461`, `community/picture.rs:534-588`, supported by `http/directory.rs:694-699` and `community/writer.rs:187-211`.

The directory excludes retired roles from `made_from`. That exclusion existed before this round, but the newly merged #141 `fold_needs` call now uses this active-only list as its test of whether a named role exists.

Concrete supported case: an unfinished workstream step needs `role:qa`; qa has no holding or queued request and is retired or merged into another role. Its document and history deliberately remain. The next view sees qa absent from `made_from` and generates a **needed** recommendation:

```text
pij directory add qa ... --project fleet
```

Even after every required placeholder is filled, the command cannot satisfy that recommendation. Add constructs the role file with `Existing::Refuse(exists(...))`, and the writer refuses because `roles/qa/role.dd.json` still exists. The view keeps repeating the same unusable advice. A merged-away role similarly should not be recreated under its retained source ID.

This is the new step-needs/lifecycle combination, not a request to re-review main's missing-role generator or repair the pre-existing core-template version of the same collision. Current retirement tests use roles without unfinished step needs; #141's missing-role test uses an actually absent role.

**Repair:** distinguish reserved retired/merged IDs from absent IDs in needed-role recommendations. Preserve the historical document and do not offer `add` for its existing address; provide an appropriate replacement/retargeting next step instead. Add a consumer-level regression for an unfinished need naming a retired role, and a merged-away source, while retaining ordinary absent-role creation.

Proof grade: source/dataflow, not a reviewer local reproduction.

## E. Other integration checks

Edit and reshape regenerate ROUTES.md inside the existing writer commit; routing-table construction excludes retired/merged roles. The #141 view preserves standing/history fields, suppresses retired-role next actions, idle recommendations, scope contribution and call-on, while active-role picture behavior remains. The idle recommendation now exposes retire/merge as commands, and parser/picture/HTTP expectations follow that intentional shipping change.

The notification-failure F002 note remains separately assigned to security. The current HTTP wiring collects `tell_withdrawn` outcomes and then calls withdrawal unconditionally; this review does not claim that note closed.

## F. Exact-head CI

[CI run 42365297866](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42365297866) names this full head; all four jobs passed. Downloaded JUnit records **2,076 executed cases, zero failures/errors**; five Rust cases were skipped separately.

Named passing cases include both new admission/re-entry/cancellation regressions, routing-table update, hostile-instance repair-command handling, interrupted withdrawal recovery, existing retirement/send fences, #141's picture, per-instance action and real-parser command replay. Both Node jobs report **2,204 Vitest passed, six skipped**, and **324 combined native-extension passed**.

The latest [Delivers run 42365593363](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42365593363) passed; PR is CLEAN. CI explicitly reports ddocs UNAVAILABLE. Green tests do not exercise F004's retained-ID/unfinished-need combination.

## G. Cost and commands

Gates and guard transfers are in-process, request-driven; no new independent timer or per-seat launch. ROUTES regeneration rides each existing commit. The delivering preflight adds an indexed role/project read. Independent performance owns queueing/commit latency and contention measurements.

Read-only git status/head/log/non-merge/remerge diffs; prior verdict and source/test reads; exact-head CI metadata/logs and downloaded JUnit inspection.

## H. Handover and harness feedback

Keep the head frozen until a repair round is authorized. Preserve the accepted F001 schedules while fixing the retired-ID recommendation and obtaining the separately owned verdicts.

**magicWand:** test view recommendations against retained lifecycle states, not only truly absent roles. A legal create command must also be able to create the address the view recommends.
